description: This Java source file defines the WorkEffortSearchSession class, which manages search options, constraints, and sorting configurations for work effort searches within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search options and static methods for processing search parameters, maintaining session-based state, and managing search constraints.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchSession
classes.description: A class that manages session-based search options, constraints, and sorting for work effort searches in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWorkEffortSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current WorkEffortSearchOptions stored in the session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes the input parameters from an HTTP request to update search constraints, sorting, and view settings within the user's session.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the current session.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the search results in the session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable constraint descriptions based on current session constraints.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the current sort order for display purposes.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves the current search options to the session history if they have been changed.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a specific constraint from the current session based on its index.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears all current search options and constraints from the session.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates search constraints, sorting options, and view state for a search session.

methods.name: getConstraintList
methods.description: Returns the list of current search constraints.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a new constraint to the current search session.

methods.name: getResultSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sort order, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setViewIndex
methods.description: Sets the view index for pagination.

methods.name: setViewSize
methods.description: Sets the view size for pagination.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Generates a list of constraint descriptions for display.

methods.name: clearViewInfo
methods.description: Clears view index and size, typically when search constraints are altered.
